Read the verdict with: aida review verdict BUG-83 (aida-host). The guards are verified solid: fail-closed gh, symlink escape blocked, live build protection, main target untouched, seed floor, hard floor. Blocking:
(1) The activity signal is .cargo-lock mtime, which is its creation time, and the seed copies main's old lock. A real dry run would have reaped aida-rv2680, a live worktree seeded 33 minutes earlier. Use builds.jsonl, a per-build stamp, or fingerprint/deps mtimes.
(2) Basename collision: by_name overwrites, so the result depends on list order. Reap only if every worktree sharing the basename qualifies.
(3) The docs and flags don't match. Also wire cargo-reap into the tick (dry-run report) and install.sh.
Mail REWORK READY. Do not mark BUG-83 completed before merge.
subject: aida-host PR #11 BUG-83: CHANGES round 1 (3 blocking)
